messages:
Alex: Quick q — projector in the lounge: does anyone have the HDMI adapter + remote? Planning a retro night (SNES > N64 > Smash) + some Steam co-op.
Sam: I can bring an HDMI switch (3 in) and a mini HDMI->HDMI adapter. Remote... maybe? I have the Logitech harmony but might be heavy. :sweat_smile: 
Nora: I have a universal IR remote that works with the projector. Also bringing extra AA batteries for controllers.
Diego: Bringing my Switch + dock. Who's up for Mario Kart tournament? I can run a simple double-elim bracket.
Tess: Sign me up for Mario Kart and Rocket League. Also I can bring a small folding table for the projector so it isn't on a laptop stack.
Alex: Awesome. Can we do a quick sign-up? Reply with which games: MK / RL / Smash / Retro (N64/SNES). I'll seed brackets based on replies.
Sam: MK + Smash.
Nora: Retro (N64) + MK. I can bring an N64 with cartridge slot cleaned.
Diego: MK + RL.
Tess: MK + RL.
room-bot: Calendar event "Retro LAN Night" created by Alex for 19:00-23:00 tomorrow in Lounge B.
Alex: Also, small infra heads-up — if you're connecting laptops to the AP for Steam Remote Play, use the guest SSID (LAN-GUEST) to avoid routing/policy issues. If you need a static IP for testing controllers or local server, use:```
# mac/linux
sudo ifconfig en0 192.168.42.20 netmask 255.255.255.0
# windows (admin)
netsh interface ip set address "Wi-Fi" static 192.168.42.20 255.255.255.0 192.168.42.1
```
Sam: Do we have enough TVs/monitors? I can bring a 32" monitor if needed.
Nora: I have one HDMI monitor spare. Between Sam's monitor and Diego's dock we should be fine.
Alex: Sweet. Prize for MK winner: a bag of office coffee beans. Runner-up gets a fancy sticker. :trophy: :sticker: 
Diego: Also heads-up: my GameCube controller has slight analog drift. If someone has a spare GC joystick piece or a cheap adapter, please bring it.
Tess: I have a Mayflash adapter for GC controllers to Switch/PC. Works fine for Smash.
Sam: Can someone bring an extra ethernet cable ~3m? Wired is better for Rocket League lobbies.
Nora: I have a 3m and a 2m. Bringing both.
Alex: Perfect. Final plan: arrive ~18:45 to set up, warm-up lobby at 19:15, MK bracket starts 19:45. If you can't make a game you signed up for, DM me so I can reseed.
Diego: Posting bracket sheet here: tinyurl.com/redwood-lan-brackets (edit access to Alex/Diego).
room-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Bring extension cords" 2 hours before event.
Tess: Anyone else want to try co-op indie on Steam as a warm-up? I heard it has couch mode and local controllers map well.
Sam: I'm down. See y'all tomorrow!
Alex: Thanks everyone — huge help on gear. See you tomorrow :party_popper:
